validation.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email, for example name@company.com.
validation.invalidVat: VAT number should be 15 digits, starting and ending with 3.
validation.invalidIban: Enter a valid Saudi IBAN (SA followed by 22 digits).
validation.invalidPhone: Enter a Saudi mobile number, for example 0512345678.
validation.invalidContactPhone: Enter a phone number with digits only, for example 0138000000.
validation.invalidIqama: Iqama number should be 10 digits, starting with 2 (or 1 for a Saudi ID).
validation.invalidPassport: Passport number should be 5 to 20 letters and digits.
validation.invalidAmount: Enter an amount in SAR, for example 1500 or 1500.50.
validation.chooseSite: Choose an active site, or leave it empty.
validation.clientExists: A client with this name already exists.
validation.siteExists: This client already has a site with this name.
validation.iqamaTaken: A worker with this Iqama number already exists (check archived workers too).
validation.restoreClientFirst: Restore the client first, then the site.
validation.clientNotFound: No active client with this name. Add the client first, or check the spelling.
validation.siteNotFound: No active site with this name. Add the site first, or check the spelling.
validation.siteAmbiguous: More than one client has a site with this name. Fill in the Client column too.
validation.duplicateInFile: This appears more than once in the file.
